# References Index

This file lists support material loaded on demand by this skill.

## How To Use

1. Start with SKILL.md.
2. Open reference files only when SKILL.md tells you to.
3. Treat references as support context, not a separate skill.

## Reference Files

- file-name.md: Purpose of the file and when to read it.
- file-name-2.md: Purpose of the file and when to read it.

## Maintenance Rules

- Keep references focused and short.
- Prefer one canonical reference per topic.
- Archive or remove superseded references.
- Update this index whenever references are added, removed, or renamed.
